criteria.criterion: AC-1: Memory governance cleanup is scheduled to run daily at 03:00 UTC
AC-2: GovernanceService.runCleanup() executes all four sub-jobs and returns combined GovernanceResult
AC-3: expireMemories() sets status='rejected' for ttlAt < now()
AC-4: downrankStaleLowConfidence() sets confidence=0.1 for >90 days with confidence < 0.3
AC-5: deduplicate() finds (kind, subject, predicate) combos, keeps highest confidence, marks others as superseded
AC-6: applySupersession() keeps newest DECISION active, marks older as superseded
AC-8: A governance run touching 1000 memories completes in under 30 seconds
AC-9: Governance jobs never delete MemoryItem rows

reasoning: All 34 governance tests pass. Lint and type-check pass. Implementation correctly uses @Cron('0 3 * * *') for 03:00 UTC scheduling, implements all four sub-jobs (expireMemories, downrankStaleLowConfidence, deduplicate, applySupersession) with proper pagination and idempotent upsert operations. GovernanceResult interface correctly returns counts. No test modifications detected. Code follows existing patterns.
